reserveReview.rationale: The issuer API listed a July 2026 bank confirmation uploaded 2026-08-11. The ATB Financial form confirms CAD 1,817,260.14 in a Business Growth Plus deposit as of 2026-07-31. The single disclosed reserve asset is Canadian-dollar cash at the named bank. The form is not an accountant's opinion or audit and does not state CADC circulation or reconcile liabilities; account number, account legal safeguards, and withdrawal terms remain undisclosed.
